meta.intensity_reason: France PA mandate under 8 weeks away (1 Sept 2026) with PA registration ~50% - Cegid closes EUR 1.1bn Shine acquisition (1M+ SMBs, 15,000 accountants across 7 markets) - Pennylane now live in Germany and valued at USD 4.25bn - converging FR/ES/DE/PT compliance deadlines
meta.ifyrne: Cegid's aggressive expansion in Germany via the sevDesk acquisition and in Portugal through PHC acquisition, coupled with their 100 new French sales reps, presents a significant competitive threat across key WiSE markets. While Sage France is emphasizing readiness for the September 2026 e-invoicing mandate, we must accelerate our own compliance and integration efforts to counter Pennylane's impending Spanish launch and Cegid's growing presence in Germany. The unresolved GE-Active sync and stalled PA registration further amplify these risks, making swift action imperative. This week, Sage must prioritize the resolution of the GE-Active sync to ensure seamless integration for our German accountants.
meta.last_scan_summary: Manual deep refresh - data current as of 7 July 2026

summaries.FR: Market signals in France show a critical regulatory deadline approaching with low business awareness, a significant competitive consolidation, and an expansion in the document capture market.
summaries.DE: The German market shows significant activity with DATEV's major cloud migration, Cegid's aggressive expansion via sevDesk acquisition, and Lexware's technological enhancements on AWS, indicating a dynamic competitive and technological landscape.
summaries.PT: Recent market signals for Portugal indicate a continued evolution of e-invoicing and SAF-T regulations, with key deadlines for QES and SAF-T accounting approaching, alongside significant competitive consolidation through Cegid's acquisition of PHC.
summaries.Pennylane: No new signals detected in the last 48 hours regarding Pennylane.

signals.title: Cegid Acquires PHC Software, Strengthening Iberian and Lusophone Market Position
signals.body: Cegid Group completed the acquisition of Portuguese technology company PHC Business Software in January 2025. PHC serves approximately 37,000 client companies and 170,000 users across Portugal, Spain, Angola, and Mozambique. This acquisition significantly boosts Cegid's presence in the management software solutions market for SMEs in the Iberian Peninsula and Portuguese-speaking Africa.
signals.implication: The acquisition of PHC by Cegid, a major competitor, intensifies competition in the Portuguese market, particularly for SME solutions. Sage needs to monitor Cegid's integration strategy and product offerings closely.
signals.source: PitchBook, Cegid Group, Dinheiro Vivo, updated through early 2026

signals.title: Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) Mandatory for PDF Invoices in Portugal from Jan 2027
signals.body: Starting January 1, 2027, all PDF invoices in Portugal, unless exchanged via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), must include a Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) to be considered valid for fiscal purposes. This requirement was postponed from an earlier date, giving businesses until the end of 2026 to adapt.
signals.implication: Sage must ensure its invoicing solutions for Portugal support QES integration by the January 2027 deadline to maintain compliance and marketability.

signals.title: Lexware (Haufe Group) leverages AWS for cloud accounting software performance.
signals.body: Lexware, a leading German accounting software provider with 250,000 active users (lexoffice), has migrated its infrastructure to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to enhance performance, reliability, and scalability. This migration has resulted in a 50% reduction in response times and improved ability to handle usage peaks. Lexware is also developing new features as microservices on AWS.
signals.implication: This indicates continued investment and technological advancement by Lexware in its cloud offerings. While not a direct competitive threat to Sage's core products, it shows Lexware's commitment to a robust cloud infrastructure, which could enhance its market position against other cloud accounting solutions in Germany.

signals.title: Cegid acquires sevDesk, strengthening its cloud SMB offering in German-speaking Europe.
signals.body: Cegid has acquired sevDesk, a German provider of digital invoicing and accounting solutions for micro and SMB businesses. This acquisition expands Cegid's presence in German-speaking Europe, a market with over 5 million SMBs and growing demand for cloud software and e-invoicing compliance. SevDesk serves over 130,000 customers and processes over €85 billion in invoiced transactions.
signals.implication: Cegid's acquisition of sevDesk directly increases competitive pressure in the German cloud SMB market, particularly for Sage Active and potentially Sage for Accountants. This move by Cegid, a significant European player, signals an aggressive expansion strategy into Germany, which could impact Sage's market share and growth plans.

signals.title: Cegid-EBP merger to create a dominant French accounting software player
signals.body: Cegid's acquisition of EBP, announced in April 2024, will combine two major French software providers. EBP has 275,000 clients and €65M ARR, while Cegid aims to accelerate its European strategy for small businesses. The merged entity will serve nearly 750,000 clients and has a strong focus on cloud, AI, and electronic invoicing.
signals.implication: This merger significantly strengthens Cegid's position in the French market, posing a direct competitive threat to Sage's offerings for expert-comptable channel.

signals.title: Low TPE/PME awareness of French e-invoicing mandate (Sept 2026)
signals.body: A recent survey by the CNOEC indicates that less than a third of businesses know which e-invoicing platform they will choose, with nearly half unaware of any accredited platforms. This highlights a significant gap in readiness for the September 1, 2026 mandate.
signals.implication: Sage needs to accelerate customer education and platform adoption to ensure compliance and avoid potential fines for businesses.

signals.title: Pennylane actively hiring for Country Manager and Tax Assistant roles in Germany
signals.body: Pennylane is actively recruiting for a Country Manager in Poland and a Tax Assistant in Germany, indicating a strong push for market penetration in these regions. The company aims to scale operations, increase market share, and expand into new segments within these countries.
signals.implication: Pennylane's direct hiring for key roles in Germany and Poland signals a serious commitment to these markets, posing a direct threat to Sage's planned launches and existing presence.
signals.source: Page Executive, Pennylane (Remote Job Listings) - Jul 2026

signals.title: Germany clarifies B2B e-invoicing mandate deadlines for 2027 and 2028
signals.body: From January 1, 2027, German businesses with prior-year revenue above €800,000 must issue structured electronic invoices. By January 1, 2028, this obligation extends to all VAT-registered businesses. Paper and PDF invoices will no longer suffice for in-scope businesses after December 31, 2026.
signals.implication: Increased urgency for businesses and their software providers to ensure XRechnung/ZUGFeRD compliance for B2B transactions, impacting Sage Active's Verifactu-certification in Spain.

signals.title: Holded announces Verifactu readiness for its SMB platform
signals.body: Holded, a key competitor in the Spanish SMB market, has announced that its platform will be fully compliant with the Verifactu electronic invoicing requirements well ahead of the 2027 deadlines. This includes seamless integration for its 80,000 customers.
signals.implication: Sage Active must ensure its Verifactu solution is competitive and clearly communicated to the Spanish SMB market, highlighting its advantages over Holded's offering.

signals.title: Pennylane rumored to accelerate Spain launch amid market interest
signals.body: Industry sources suggest Pennylane may be exploring an earlier-than-planned entry into the Spanish market, potentially H2 2026, driven by strong demand from 'asesorias' (accounting firms) and the upcoming Verifactu mandate. This could put pressure on Sage for Accountants' Spain launch.
signals.implication: Sage WiSE needs to assess the competitive threat from Pennylane's potential early entry and accelerate its own Spain market strategy, particularly for Sage for Accountants.

signals.title: AEAT provides Verifactu guidance ahead of 2027 deadline
signals.body: The Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT) has released updated guidelines and FAQs regarding the Verifactu electronic invoicing mandate, clarifying technical requirements and compliance pathways for businesses and self-employed individuals. The mandate is set to take full effect for corporations in January 2027 and for the self-employed in July 2027.
signals.implication: Sage Active and AutoEntry+AKAO need to ensure full Verifactu compliance and communicate readiness to Spanish accountants and SMBs to avoid potential fines and retain market share.

signals.title: Cegid and EBP Alliance Intensifies Competition in French Accountant Market
signals.body: Cegid and EBP have solidified their partnership, with EBP (a Cegid Company) actively targeting French accounting practices. EBP offers specific solutions for accountants, including a 'CJEC' offer at a reduced price for members. This strategic move by Cegid aims to capture a larger share of the French expert-comptable channel.
signals.implication: Sage needs to counter Cegid's aggressive expansion in the French market by highlighting the unique value proposition of Sage for Accountants and its readiness for upcoming regulatory changes.

signals.title: Holded actively preparing for Verifactu compliance
signals.body: Holded, a significant player in the Spanish market, is actively working to ensure its software complies with Verifactu regulations. They are positioning themselves as a solution provider for businesses needing to adapt to the new invoicing system.
signals.implication: Holded's proactive approach to Verifactu compliance could give them an advantage in the Spanish market, especially among SMEs and freelancers who are looking for straightforward solutions. This highlights the need for Sage Active to clearly communicate its own Verifactu readiness.

signals.title: Pennylane confirms Spain entry plans for H2 2026
signals.body: Pennylane, a French fintech startup, has secured significant funding and plans to establish a presence in Spain in the second half of 2026. The company focuses on a unified accounting and financial management platform for SMEs and accountants, with a strong emphasis on AI.
signals.implication: Pennylane's entry into Spain before Sage for Accountants (SfA) Spain launch presents a direct competitive threat. Their AI focus and significant funding suggest a strong market push.

signals.title: France's E-invoicing Mandate Looms: Businesses Urged to Prepare for Sept 1, 2026 Deadline
signals.body: As France's mandatory e-invoicing reform approaches on September 1, 2026, businesses are being strongly advised to select compliant invoicing software and partner platforms. The DGFiP has published a list of registered platforms, with over a hundred currently approved. Non-compliance by the deadline carries a penalty of €15 per invoice.
signals.implication: Sage Active and Sage for Accountants must ensure their French offerings are fully compliant and that partners are aware of the upcoming mandate and available solutions. Highlighting compliance features will be crucial for customer acquisition and retention.

signals.title: Portugal's Accounting SAF-T Submission Delayed to 2028
signals.body: The mandatory submission of the annual SAF-T accounting file in Portugal has been postponed to 2028, applying to the fiscal year 2027 data. This is the latest in a series of delays for this requirement, which was originally planned for earlier years. Businesses must still be able to produce this file on demand during tax inspections.
signals.implication: This delay provides additional time for Sage to ensure its solutions are fully compliant with the SAF-T accounting file requirements, potentially reducing immediate development pressure but also extending the period of dual compliance needs.
signals.source: Comarch (Dec 2025), EDICOM (Dec 2025), Invoice Data Extraction (Mar 2026), Comarch (Dec 2025), Portugal Delays E-Signature and Accounting SAF-T Requirements to 2027 and 2028 (Dec 2025)

signals.title: Germany's XRechnung mandate for e-invoicing set for January 2028.
signals.body: Germany is implementing a mandatory e-invoicing system, XRechnung, which is scheduled to take effect in January 2028. This regulation aims to standardize electronic invoice exchange, particularly for business transactions. XRechnung is a purely XML-based format developed for use in the German public sector, though its adoption is expanding.
signals.implication: The upcoming XRechnung mandate is a critical deadline for all businesses operating in Germany. Sage must ensure its products, particularly Sage for Accountants and Sage Active, are fully compliant and can facilitate XRechnung generation and processing for its German customers to avoid penalties and maintain market relevance.
signals.source: E-invoices in Germany: ZUGFeRD or XRechnung?

signals.title: Lexware Office claims market leadership in German cloud accounting with 350k+ customers.
signals.body: In 2025, Lexware Office reported over 350,000 customers, positioning itself as the market leader for online accounting software in Germany. The solution is TÜV Rheinland-certified and built on a cloud-native software base with an API structure for app integration.
signals.implication: Lexware's strong market share in cloud accounting for SMBs in Germany is a direct challenge. Sage needs to differentiate its offerings and highlight the unique value propositions of Sage Active and Sage for Accountants in this competitive landscape.

signals.title: AutoEntry highlights AI-powered document capture for accountants and SMEs
signals.body: AutoEntry continues to promote its AI-powered cloud solution for automating data entry from invoices, receipts, and expenses, aiming to streamline accounting workflows for accountants and SMEs. The service captures, analyzes, and records data, publishing it directly into accounting software. Recent updates focus on improved login experience and overall performance and stability.
signals.implication: The ongoing development and promotion of AI-driven document capture solutions like AutoEntry underscore the increasing importance of this technology in the accounting sector. Sage needs to ensure its document capture solutions (AutoEntry+AKAO) remain competitive.

signals.title: Cegid and EBP integrate Cegid's PDP for French e-invoicing mandate
signals.body: Cegid has announced the native integration of its Partner Dematerialization Platform (PDP) into Cegid and EBP solutions for accounting professionals and their clients. This integration aims to help accounting firms comply with the French e-invoicing reform, which begins progressively in September 2026. The move addresses the critical need for accounting firms to manage the collection of accounting documents, particularly invoices, in light of the reform.
signals.implication: This integration strengthens Cegid and EBP's offering for the French market, particularly for accounting firms preparing for the e-invoicing mandate. It highlights a competitive move to secure the expert-comptable channel.

signals.title: Sage France emphasizes readiness for mandatory e-invoicing in 2026
signals.body: Sage France is actively promoting its solutions, including Sage for Accountants and Sage Active, as being compliant with the upcoming mandatory e-invoicing reform scheduled for September 1, 2026. They highlight that their platforms are already integrated with an approved e-invoicing platform and offer this without additional cost. Sage is also offering a specific solution, Sage Accès PA, for businesses not currently using Sage for invoicing.
signals.implication: Sage is positioning itself as a compliant solution provider for the French e-invoicing mandate, which could attract businesses seeking to meet regulatory requirements. This reinforces the importance of Sage Active's PA-certified status.

signals.title: Cegid Acquires PHC, Bolstering Iberian Presence
signals.body: Cegid Group acquired Portuguese technology company PHC Business Software in January 2025, integrating 262 employees and expanding its reach to 37,000 client companies and 170,000 users across Portugal and Spain. This acquisition significantly boosts Cegid's growth in the management software solutions market for SMEs in the Iberian Peninsula.
signals.implication: The acquisition of PHC by Cegid strengthens their competitive position in Portugal, potentially impacting market share and requiring a reassessment of competitive strategies.
signals.source: Cegid, PHC Business Software, updated as of January 2025

signals.title: DATEV begins cloud migration of core accounting and tax modules in Autumn 2026
signals.body: DATEV is migrating its on-premises software to cloud-based delivery, starting with its Kanzleimanagement (practice management) module. This will be followed by Lohn (payroll), Finanzbuchhaltung (financial accounting), and tax modules, with on-premises versions being phased out over the coming years. This migration is not expected to change underlying data formats or ZUGFeRD compatibility, but interfaces and workflows will change.
signals.implication: This cloud shift by DATEV could impact how accountants integrate with their systems, potentially creating opportunities for Sage if DATEV's transition is not seamless or if it opens doors for alternative cloud solutions.

signals.title: Pennylane Offers Integrated PA Solution Ahead of Mandate
signals.body: Pennylane is positioning itself as a 4-in-1 solution, including an integrated accredited platform (PA) for electronic invoicing. They are making this PA functionality available for free to their existing clients, even before the September 1, 2026, mandate deadline. This proactive integration aims to provide a seamless compliance experience for their users.
signals.implication: Pennylane's early and integrated offering of PA functionality creates a competitive advantage. Sage needs to ensure its own PA-compliant solutions are easily accessible and clearly communicated to the market, emphasizing any unique benefits or integrations.

signals.title: France's PA Mandate: Expert-Comptable Readiness and Tools Emerge
signals.body: The French Ordre des experts-comptables is actively preparing accountants for the September 1, 2026, PA mandate. They are offering resources like the 'Quelle PA' platform to help firms choose accredited platforms and providing workshops on the reform's implications. This indicates a proactive approach by the accounting profession to comply with the upcoming electronic invoicing requirements.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions are fully compliant and easily integrated with the chosen PA platforms by accountants. Highlighting Sage's own readiness and support for the mandate will be crucial.

signals.title: Portugal extends PDF e-invoice validity to Dec 31, 2026; QES mandatory from Jan 1, 2027
signals.body: The Portuguese Parliament has approved a delay, extending the validity of PDF invoices as legally recognized electronic invoices until December 31, 2026. Consequently, a Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) will be mandatory for all non-EDI electronic invoices, including PDFs, starting January 1, 2027. This also postpones the mandatory submission of the SAF-T Accounting file to 2028, covering the 2027 fiscal year.
signals.implication: Sage Active and Sage for Accountants need to ensure their solutions support QES for Portuguese clients by Jan 2027. The SAF-T Accounting delay provides a slight buffer but planning for its 2028 implementation remains critical.
signals.source: Multiple sources, including Vertex AI Search results dated between March 2026 and December 2025.

signals.title: French e-invoicing mandate details and preparation guidance
signals.body: The French Directorate General of Public Finance (DGFiP) is enforcing a deep change in invoice exchange with a mandate starting September 1, 2026. All VAT-liable businesses must be able to receive e-invoices in structured formats (Factur-X, UBL, CII). Large companies and ETIs must also issue e-invoices, while SMEs and micro-enterprises have until September 1, 2027. A fine of €15 per invoice applies for non-compliance.
signals.implication: The approaching deadline for the French PA mandate underscores the urgency for all businesses and accounting professionals to adopt compliant solutions. Competitors are actively marketing their readiness, creating pressure on Sage to demonstrate its own compliance and support for its customers.

signals.title: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate extends to all businesses by Jan 2028
signals.body: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate, requiring structured invoices in formats like XRechnung or ZUGFeRD, will fully apply to all businesses by January 2028. This phased implementation began with mandatory receipt of e-invoices in January 2025, followed by larger companies issuing them from January 2027, and all remaining businesses by January 2028.
signals.implication: Sage must ensure SfA and other relevant products are fully compliant with XRechnung/ZUGFeRD standards and that customers are aware of the upcoming deadlines to avoid penalties.

signals.title: Pennylane's expansion into Spain poses a threat to Sage's planned launch.
signals.body: Pennylane, a competitor with €115M ARR and valued at $4.25B, is set to launch in Spain in H2 2026. This move is particularly concerning as it precedes Sage for Accountants' (SfA) planned Spain launch, indicating a potential first-mover advantage for Pennylane in the Spanish market.
signals.implication: This competitive move directly impacts Sage's strategic expansion plans in Spain. Sage needs to accelerate its launch or develop a robust counter-strategy to mitigate Pennylane's early market entry and potential customer acquisition.
signals.source: Pennylane (FR primary, ES H2 2026, DE live — €115M ARR, $4.25B, 6k+ firms)

signals.title: Cegid EBP hires 100 new sales reps targeting French accounting practices.
signals.body: Cegid, following its acquisition of EBP, has hired 100 new sales representatives in Q2 2026. This significant expansion of their sales force is specifically aimed at targeting accounting practices in France, intensifying competition in the expert-comptable channel.
signals.implication: This move directly threatens Sage's market share in France, particularly within the accounting professional channel. Sage needs to anticipate increased competitive pressure and potentially adjust its sales and marketing strategies to counter Cegid's aggressive expansion.
signals.source: Cegid+Shine+EBP (FR/ES/PT/DE — 100 new FR sales reps Q2 2026)

signals.title: Sage Active positioned for French e-invoicing compliance
signals.body: Sage Active is being marketed as an all-in-one online solution optimized by AI for small businesses, which includes managing invoicing and accounting in compliance with e-invoicing regulations. Sage highlights that its solutions are already compatible with e-invoicing and e-reporting, and that Sage is registered as an approved platform (PA) for the French mandate.
signals.implication: While Sage is promoting Sage Active's compliance, the competitive moves by Cegid/EBP and the market's focus on the PA mandate require continuous monitoring of Sage's market position and customer adoption in France.

signals.title: France's PA mandate implementation details clarified
signals.body: The French Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) has provided further details on the upcoming electronic invoicing mandate, set to begin September 1, 2026. All VAT-registered businesses must be able to receive e-invoices in a structured format (Factur-X, UBL, or CII). Large and intermediate-sized companies must also issue e-invoices, while SMEs and micro-enterprises will have an additional year for issuance. New mandatory invoice fields, including customer SIREN and delivery address, will also be required.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions fully support the mandated e-invoicing formats and reporting requirements for all business sizes in France by the September 2026 deadline.

signals.title: Cegid Primavera Pushes Cloud for New Implementations in 2026
signals.body: Cegid Primavera is recommending its Evolution Cloud (SaaS) version for new implementations in 2026, positioning it as the natural destination for migrations from older on-premise versions. This strategic shift towards cloud services by a major competitor warrants close monitoring.
signals.implication: This indicates a strong push by Cegid into the cloud ERP market in Portugal, potentially increasing competition for Sage Active's cloud SMB offering.
signals.source: Cegid Primavera Partner Documentation, updated as of July 2026

signals.title: MyUnisoft offers free e-invoicing solution for French micro-enterprises and SMEs
signals.body: MyUnisoft is offering a free 'First' solution for micro-enterprises and SMEs, which includes e-invoicing emission and reception starting September 1, 2026. The solution includes their 'Plateforme Agréée' (PA) at no extra cost. This move aims to capture a significant portion of the market by offering a no-cost entry point for compliance.
signals.implication: A competitor, MyUnisoft, is launching a free tier for the critical French e-invoicing mandate. This aggressive pricing strategy could attract a large number of small businesses and micro-enterprises, potentially impacting Sage's market share if not countered with competitive offerings or clear value propositions.

signals.title: Sage Active Integrates AI for Enhanced Accounting Features
signals.body: Sage Active is being enhanced with AI capabilities, as indicated by references to 'Sage Active with AI' for accounting, reporting, and easier data entry. This development aims to improve the efficiency and user experience of the platform for French SMBs.
signals.implication: The integration of AI into Sage Active could improve its competitive standing by offering more advanced features. However, it's crucial to monitor how these AI enhancements compare to competitors' offerings and their actual impact on user productivity.
signals.source: Sage Active - Logiciel de gestion (Accessed July 23, 2026)

signals.title: Pennylane Accelerates European Expansion, Targeting Germany, Spain, Poland, Belgium
signals.body: Pennylane has officially entered the German market in November 2025 and plans to establish a presence in Poland, Spain, and Belgium. The company's expansion is fueled by significant funding and a strategy to become the leading financial OS for European SMEs.
signals.implication: Pennylane's proactive expansion into key Sage markets, particularly Spain, before Sage's own launch, represents a significant competitive threat and potential first-mover advantage.
signals.source: Arabian FinTech, EU-Startups, Tech.eu, Startbase, TCV, Business Model Canvas Templates, 2025-2026

signals.title: Pennylane Deepens Focus on French Accountant Channel
signals.body: Pennylane is actively integrating with a wide array of accounting tools and services, signaling a strong push to become the preferred platform for French accountants. Their strategy involves automating workflows for accountants, from client onboarding to financial reporting, and emphasizing their French origin and long-term commitment to the market.
signals.implication: Pennylane's aggressive expansion and integration strategy poses a significant threat to Sage's accountant channel in France. Need to counter with strong value propositions and demonstrate superior integration capabilities.

signals.title: France PA Mandate Deadline Approaching: Businesses Urged to Select Platform
signals.body: With the French PA mandate deadline of September 1, 2026, rapidly approaching, businesses are reminded that they must select an approved platform to issue and receive electronic invoices. Failure to comply can result in fines of €15 per invoice. Sage is promoting its integrated PA Sage solution, emphasizing its readiness and ease of integration for businesses.
signals.implication: Urgent need for Sage to ensure SfA and Sage Active are fully compliant and actively marketed as PA-ready solutions. Highlight the risks of non-compliance and the benefits of early adoption.

signals.title: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate phases in from January 2027
signals.body: Starting January 1, 2027, German businesses with prior-year revenue above €800,000 must issue structured electronic invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD 2.x, or EN 16931-compliant). This obligation extends to all VAT-registered businesses by January 1, 2028. Paper and PDF invoices will no longer be legally compliant for in-scope businesses after December 31, 2026.
signals.implication: This regulatory deadline is a critical driver for adoption of compliant software. Sage must ensure its solutions fully support XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats and actively market this compliance to German businesses and accountants.

signals.title: Verifactu deadlines confirmed for Jan 2027 (companies) and Jul 2027 (self-employed)
signals.body: The Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT) has confirmed the mandatory implementation of the Verifactu system for invoicing. Companies must comply by January 1, 2027, and self-employed individuals by July 1, 2027. This system aims to ensure invoice integrity, traceability, and unalterability to combat tax fraud. Fines for non-compliance can reach €50,000.
signals.implication: Sage Active must be fully compliant with Verifactu requirements for the Spanish market by the specified deadlines. Proactive communication and support for Spanish customers are crucial to ensure a smooth transition and avoid penalties.
